worktree.definition: A separate working copy of your project. Flint can make changes there without touching the copy you are working in, and you decide what to keep.

context.definition: The information included in the conversation that the model reads before it answers: your messages, attached files, instructions and anything Flint adds.

mcpServer.definition: A connection that gives Flint additional tools, such as reading a database or calling a service. Some run on this computer; some contact external services.

checkpoint.definition: A saved point that can restore supported state, such as project files Flint changed. It cannot undo messages already sent or anything that happened outside this computer.

agent.definition: An assistant working on a task: it can plan, use tools and take several steps, asking permission where needed.
